'''Derek "Hobbie" Klivian''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] from the [[planet]] [[Ralltiir]] who served as a [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He attended the [[Skystrike Academy]] with [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Rake Gahree]]. He and Antilles [[Escape from Skystrike Academy|defected]] to the rebellion after making contact with [[Sabine Wren]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin]], [[Luke Skywalker]] invited Klivian to join [[Rogue Squadron]]. Klivian accepted and served the unit with distinction during the [[Battle of Hoth]] where he [[Death|sacrificed himself]] by crashing his [[T-47 airspeeder]] into [[Maximilian Veers]]'s [[All Terrain Armored Transport]], [[Blizzard 1]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Derek Klivian [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the [[planet]] [[Ralltiir]]<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> and, since the [[time]] of his [[Youngling|childhood]], was a gifted [[pilot]]. At some point in his childhood, he gained the nickname of "Hobbie." Throughout his life, he introduced himself as Hobbie, asking people to address him by his nickname and saying that he hated the name Derek.<ref name="OTFL" />

====Skystrike Academy====
{{Quote|We made our choice.|Derek Klivian to Sabine Wren|<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" />}}
Klivian honed his piloting skills at [[Skystrike Academy]],<ref name="OTFL" /> an elite [[Imperial Academy|flight academy]] on the planet [[Montross]], training under [[Flight instructor|Instructor]] [[Goran]].<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" /> He trained others in [[asteroid]] running and no-instrument navigation.<ref name="OTFL" /> One day Klivian met fellow pilot [[Wedge Antilles]] while playing several hands of Sabacc at their barracks.<ref name="FACPOV">{{StoryCite|story=Rendezvous Point (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref> [[Gender|He]] also met [[Rake Gahree]].<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" /> However, Klivian, along with many of his peers, eventually wanted to contact the growing rebellion against the Empire and use his skills to fight.<ref name="OTFL" />

Antilles and Gahree were also discontent with the direction they felt the Empire was taking and made plans to defect to the rebellion. This information eventually made its way to one of the many [[Fulcrum]] [[agent]]s,<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" /> who became the link Klivian needed.<ref name="OTFL" /> Fulcrum passed the information to the [[Phoenix Cell]].<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" />

[[File:Hobbie-Klivian.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Derek Klivian and Wedge Antilles imprisoned in Skystrike Academy]]
The information also caught the attention of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], which dispatched [[Lothal sector]]'s [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] as well as agent [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] to investigate the claims. Klivian, Antilles, and Gahree argued that they knew about their planned defection. However, fellow [[Imperial cadet|cadet]] Ria Talla, secretly undercover [[Spectres|rebel]] [[Sabine Wren]], overheard and told Antilles that she would help them defect.<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" />

Later, Klivian and his friends found an opportunity to escape when Goran ordered the [[cadet]]s to take part in a mock combat exercise in [[Realspace|space]]. Wren arranged for her rebel comrades [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Kanan Jarrus]] to rendezvous their [[CR90 corvette]] near the planet. At Wren's signal, Klivian and his comrades flew towards the rebel [[corvette]]. However, Pryce deactivated the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIEs']] [[solar collector]] panels, leaving them derelict in space. Pryce also ordered [[Captain]] [[Vult Skerris]] to shoot one of the TIE pods as a warning; [[Death|claiming]] the life of Rake. Klivian, Wren, and Antilles were soon arrested by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" />

Following their capture, Antilles and Klivian were thrown into a holding cell by Kallus. Inside the two debated their escape plans, with Antilles suggesting they surprise the guards. A demoralized Klivian was dubious of their chances of success due to the lack of an escape plan. Fortunately for them, they were rescued by Wren, who had managed to knock out Governor Pryce. The defectors and Wrne then fled down a corridor, only to run into Agent Kallus. However, the ISB agent had a change of heart due to his previous encounter with Wren's rebel cell and allowed them to escape.<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" />

[[File:The_Antilles_Extraction_thumb.png|250px|right|Cadet Klivian alongside Antilles and Wren|thumb|right]]
Heading to [[Hangar]] 24, Klivian and his friends [[Escape from Skystrike Academy|fled]] on a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE bomber]]. They managed to flee into the atmosphere but were pursued by Captain Skerris. At the eleventh [[Standard hour|hour]], they were rescued by Bridger's CR90 corvette and managed to flee aboard. Klivian, Antilles, and their rebel rescuers traveled to the Phoenix [[Chopper Base|Base]] on [[Atollon]]. There, Antilles and Klivian were greeted by [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]] who formally welcomed them into the rebellion.<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" /> Eventually, the two distinguished themselves in their early engagements.<ref name="OTFL" />

===Serving in Phoenix Cell===
====Training exercise====
{{Quote|Hobbie, Wedge, let's go! Move it!|Hera Syndulla, to Antilles and Klivian|<ref name="Warhead" />}}
[[File:Hobbie_Wedge_Warhead.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Klivian and Antilles prepare for a training mission.]]
A short while after his defection from the Empire, Klivian, along with the rest of the Spectres and Phoenix Squadron were to take part in a training exercise. Shortly before they left, Klivian and Antilles were conversing in the hanger despite the fact that they were behind schedule. They suddenly heard Syndulla call for them, and in the shock to get ready, the two ran straight into each other. In their absence after they left, Chopper Base was [[EXD-9's infiltration of Chopper Base|infiltrated]] by the [[E-XD-series infiltrator droid]] [[EXD-9]], who was searching the [[Outer Rim Territories]] for rebel bases. The [[Lasat]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]], the inventory droid [[AP-5]], and the [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]] managed to capture and reprogram the droid as an improvised rigged bomb which destroyed an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Warhead" />

===Alliance to Restore the Republic===
====Atollon====
{{Quote|Hobbie, follow me.|Antilles signals Klivian during the dogfight.|<ref name="Zero Hour">{{Rebels|Zero Hour}}</ref>}}
[[File:DerekKlivianRZ1Awing-SWZ83.png|thumb|right|250px|Klivian flew as part of Phoenix Squadron during the Battle of Atollon.]]
Eventually, all of the individual rebel cells grouped together to reorganize into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref> Just as Phoenix Squadron had been preparing to make an attack on the Imperial factory on Lothal, [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] managed to discover the location of Chopper Base, and subsequently launched an all-out attack in an attempt to finally thwart out their rebel actives, who had become a legitimate threat to the Empire. During the ground assault, Klivian, Antilles, and two other rebel pilots launched their [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing starfighters]] in order to counter the [[All Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT walkers]] that had been stationed on the planet's surface. With Antilles signaling Klivian to follow him, the duo attempted to attack the walkers; however, Thrawn quickly took note of their excursion and dispatched TIE fighters to repel them. The A-wings and the TIE-fighters consequently engaged in a dogfight. Towards the latter part of the battle, the two managed to escape, along with the remnants of Phoenix Squadron and [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]]'s [[Massassi Group]], to [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="Zero Hour" />

====''Rand Ecliptic'' mutiny====
[[File:Biggs.png|thumb|left|200px|Klivian assisted Imperial cadet Biggs Darklighter in defecting.]]
Around this time, Klivian went undercover<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars NE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> and attended the [[Imperial Naval Academy|Prefsbelt Fleet Camp]]<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Hobbie Klivian - Snowspeeder Gunner}}</ref> with [[Biggs Darklighter]]. Together they were posted to the Imperial [[starship]] ''[[Rand Ecliptic]]'',<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars NE" /> aboard which Darklighter received the commission of [[First Mate|first mate]].<ref name="CL 2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> In a similar manner to Wren [[Standard year|years]] before, Klivian helped Darklighter [[Mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic|defect]] to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars NE" />

===Galactic Civil War===
====Scarif====
By [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Klivian was a member of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]], stationed at [[Great Temple|Base One]] on Yavin 4. During the [[Battle of Scarif|mission]] to steal the [[Death Star plans|technical readouts]] of the secret [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]], he served as the standby for [[Red Six]], although the position was ultimately filled by [[Jek Tono Porkins]].<ref name="UVG" /> Klivian tried to comfort his friend Antilles after he had been left off the duty roster for the battle.<ref name="FACPOV" />

====Yavin====
Days later, it was Klivian's turn to be comforted by Antilles, after learning that he would not be participating in the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="FACPOV" />

====Mako-Ta====
{{Quote|I hope this isn't weird but…I just wanted to say I'm honored to meet you, sir.|Derek Klivian, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SW 45">[[Star Wars (2015) 45|''Star Wars'' (2015) 45]]</ref>}}
Months later, he and Antilles took part in a training run sponsored by Syndulla. There they met [[Zev Senesca]]. The trio became friends based on the meeting. As the rebellion recovered and gathered their forces at [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]], the pilots met up with Red Squadron and would-be Jedi [[Luke Skywalker]] in [[Mess Hall IV]].<ref name="SW 45" /> Shortly after, the [[Galactic Empire]] launched an [[Battle of Mako-Ta|assault]] on the Alliance's base. Klivian was stuck aboard the<ref name="Star Wars 51">[[Star Wars (2015) 51|''Star Wars'' (2015) 51]]</ref> [[Star Cruiser]] [[Republic (MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser)|''Republic'']]<ref name="Star Wars 55">[[Star Wars (2015) 55|''Star Wars'' (2015) 55]]</ref> with other pilots such as Skywalker, Antilles, and Senesca. Thanks to [[Han Solo]], the Rebel starfighters were eventually able to launch into battle, with Klivian, serving as a member of [[Rogue Squadron]], an adhoc unit formed by Skywalker during the battle in honor of the actions of [[Jyn Erso]].<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref>

====Hoth====
[[File:Hobbie-TESB40.png|thumb|right|200px|Klivian prepares his snowspeeder for the battle.]]
After the Battle of [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]], Skywalker invited Klivian to join Rogue Squadron. Klivian joined,<ref name="SWCT" /> and he and Antilles became core members of the elite group.<ref name="OTFL" /> Klivian and Antilles flew together at multiple engagements, including the [[Battle of Distilon]], the [[Battle of Perimako Major]], and at least a dozen other worlds.<ref name="FACPOV" />

The Rebel Alliance eventually came to be stationed at [[Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth]]. After the rebel presence on the planet was discovered by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron]], Klivian and other [[starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot|pilots]] attended a briefing by [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] prior to the impending [[Battle of Hoth]]. Klivian and Rogue Squadron would fly [[T-47 airspeeder|T-47 snowspeeders]],<ref name="ESB" /> with the squadron's [[X-wing starfighter]]s kept in reserve to escape Hoth,<ref name="OTFL" /> to delay the landing [[Imperial Army|Imperial ground]] [[Imperial Military|forces]] while the rest of the station evacuated. Once this task was completed, the pilots would escort each individual [[transport]] away from the base, past the Imperial [[blockade]]. Skeptical that two fighters would be able to fight their way past an Imperial Star Destroyer, Organa nevertheless assured him that the base's [[V-150 Planet Defender|v-150]] [[ion cannon]] would provide enough cover for the escape.<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:Walker_Assault_DICE.png|thumb|left|220px|Klivian and Rogue Squadron fly T-47 airspeeders against the Imperial ground assault.]]
During the battle against the Empire's AT-AT [[walker]]s, Klivian served as Skywalker's wingman,<ref name="ESB" /> and he remained in the air for longer than the majority of rebel pilots. In addition to a high casualty rate, however, the rebels also lost their base's [[deflector shield generator]] to General [[Maximilian Veers]]'s walker, [[Blizzard 1]]. After a hit crippled his snowspeeder, Klivian did not eject from his ship and instead crashed it into the head of Blizzard 1, dying. With the walker now decapitated, Klivian's maneuver had saved numerous rebels from its cannons and blunted the Imperial advance.<ref name="OTFL" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Every time I drink a Klivian I think of old Hobbie.|Wes Janson|<ref name="The Buy-In">{{StoryCite|story=The Buy-In|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}</ref>}}
Klivian had a strong relationship with Antilles, having defected together from the Empire. He was also friends with squadron-mates like Luke Skywalker and [[Wes Janson]]. At one point, Klivian participated in making a citrusy, [[potato]]-based liquor, which they brewed in a hollowed-out [[R2-series astromech droid]]. After Klivian's death, fellow pilots Antilles and Janson continued the operation, eventually calling the drink a [[Klivian]]. Although it was unappetizing for most to consume, they continued to drink it as a palate cleanser and as a way to remember Klivian by.<ref name="The Buy-In" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:DerekKlivianHelmet-SW100Objects.png|thumb|right|200px|Derek Klivian's first [[K-22995 light flight helmet|flight helmet]]]]
Klivian was a [[human]] male who stood 1.75 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="Databank" /> While he was initially under the Galactic Empire as part of Skystrike Academy, Klivian and many others were discontent with the regime. Thanks to agent Fulcrum, he quickly joined the rebel [[Starfighter Corps]], ultimately serving as an X-wing [[starfighter]] jockey.<ref name="OTFL" />

==Skills and abilities==
A pilot since childhood, Klivian was a skilled enough to be in Rogue Group, a unit of X-wing aces in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="OTFL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Derek Klivian was portrayed by [[Richard Oldfield]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], in which he was credited only as "Hobbie (Rogue 4)."<ref name="ESB" /> Klivian appears as an Imperial cadet in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', voiced by [[Trevor Devall]].<ref name="The Antilles Extraction" />

[[File:Hobbie_cut_scene_TMOTESB.jpg|250px|thumb|Footage of Klivian's scene cut from ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]
Klivian was originally scripted to die in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' by crashing his T-47 airspeeder into the "head" of Blizzard 1, the All Terrain Armored Transport leading the assault on Echo Base. The scene was never finished, and thus never put in the final film. Preliminary footage of the unfinished scene was later released as part of the enhanced edition of ''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]'' book.<ref name="Making of TESB">''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Sources like the [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] on [[StarWars.com]] or the [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] say that Klivian managed to eject from the cockpit of his snowspeeder before it could crash, though the reference book ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' later contradicted that by saying Klivian died during the Battle of Hoth. The author [[Daniel Wallace]], in an interview with Eleven Thirty-Eight, clarified that the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] pointed him to the planned scene, so he could incorporate it in the book. He also speculated that the planned scene took precedence before [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], where Klivian survived the battle and lived long after.<ref name="11 38">{{WebCite|url=http://eleven-thirtyeight.com/2017/07/on-the-front-lines-an-interview-with-dan-wallace|text=On The Front Lines – An Interview with Dan Wallace|author=Nicholas W. Adams|date=2017-07-24|archivedate=20190701072711}}</ref>
